instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide-angle full shot from behind. Inside a motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor, the man in the black polo shirt (R1) stands center-left, facing away and slightly left. The woman in the white t-shirt (R2) walks forward on the center-right, reaching her left hand to touch his upper back. The woman (R2) approaches the man (R1) from behind to make contact. Soft overhead fluorescent lighting illuminates the scene.
